name: Vong doi Product Base (Archive / Duplicate / Delete)
user_goal: La owner, quan ly vong doi cua mot product base: archive/unarchive, nhan ban (duplicate), hoac xoa han khi khong con dung.

actors.permission_observed: Archive, unarchive, duplicate, delete product base thanh cong (tren 3202/3203/3234/3236), khong gap access-denied.

entry_points.precondition: dang o list /products, tab Active hoac Archived

capabilities.name: Archive product base
capabilities.description: status 0->1 qua POST /api/products/{id}/archive, khong dialog xac nhan.

capabilities.name: Unarchive
capabilities.description: POST /api/products/{id}/unarchive, tra 200; status 1->0. Da duoc thuc thi that va xac nhan trong lần khảo sát (lan dau tien co evidence cho endpoint nay).

capabilities.name: Duplicate product base (clone)
capabilities.description: Deep-copy printarea/variant/mockup/display settings sang ban ghi moi.

capabilities.name: Delete product base
capabilities.description: Goi GET deletion-check truoc. Neu allowed: dialog xac nhan 'Delete Product' -> DELETE that su chay qua REST, tra 204. Neu blocked (IN_CAMPAIGNS): dialog Warning huong dan 'View campaigns list'/'Cancel', KHONG co request DELETE nao duoc gui qua UI. Xac nhan doc lap bang cach goi thang DELETE bypass UI tren product dang IN_CAMPAIGNS: server tra 403 Forbidden {"message":"Product cannot be deleted due to policy restrictions or invalid confirmation token"}, product KHONG bi xoa - server THUC SU chan (khong chi la goi y/an nut phia UI).

capabilities.name: Xoa product base ACTIVE (chua tung archive)
capabilities.description: GET deletion-check tra allowed, DELETE tra 204 - HANH VI GIONG HET product da archive; khong bat buoc phai archive truoc khi xoa.

state_transitions.condition: POST /api/products/{id}/unarchive tra 200; campaign_products/need_sync KHONG doi qua ca archive lan unarchive
deep-copy printarea/variant/mockup/display settings voi ID moi; SKU giu nguyen; label/internal_tags giu nguyen

state_transitions.from: product base ton tai, khong campaign nao dung (bat ke da/chua archive)
product base ton tai, DANG duoc campaign dung
state_transitions.trigger: bam Delete Product (hoac goi thang DELETE bypass UI)
state_transitions.condition: deletion-check.policy='blocked' reason='IN_CAMPAIGNS'; qua UI: dialog Warning 'View campaigns list'/'Cancel', KHONG co DELETE nao duoc gui. Xac nhan doc lap bang DELETE bypass UI truc tiep: server tra 403 Forbidden {"message":"Product cannot be deleted due to policy restrictions or invalid confirmation token"}, product khong bi xoa - day la chan server-side thuc su, khong chi la UI an nut.

confirmed_rules.statement: [CHK-07-004] Server THUC SU CHAN (khong chi la UI an nut) viec DELETE mot product base dang duoc it nhat 1 campaign su dung. Hai duong bang chung doc lap dan toi cung ket luan: (1) qua UI - deletion-check.policy='blocked', reason='IN_CAMPAIGNS', dialog Warning huong dan 'View campaigns list'/'Cancel', KHONG co request DELETE nao duoc gui di; (2) bypass UI - goi thang DELETE tren product IN_CAMPAIGNS, server tra ve 403 Forbidden voi body {"message":"Product cannot be deleted due to policy restrictions or invalid confirmation token"}, product KHONG bi xoa.
[CHK-07-005] DELETE duoc chap nhan tren Product Base dang ACTIVE, CHUA TUNG archive - hanh vi giong het product da archive truoc do; KHONG bat buoc phai archive truoc khi xoa.

[CHK-07-009, business decision] Muc dich that su cua field 'token' trong response deletion-check (luon null o moi sample) hien KHONG anh huong chuc nang; day la known-limitation duoc PO chap nhan, ghi lai nhu open issue, KHONG can dieu tra them o thoi diem nay.

observed_behavior.statement: Muc xac nhan truoc thao tac pha huy/nhan ban khong nhat quan: xoa printarea - chay ngay; archive - khong hoi; duplicate - khong hoi; delete product base - CO dialog + deletion-check truoc.
Response archive tra full record, lo 2 field chua tung thay o response khac (variants_position, print_provider_id).
Response clone (POST /clone) la chinh record NGUON (3203), khong phai ban sao (3206) - portal phai refetch list de biet id ban sao, khong dieu huong sang ban sao.
Clone copy title kem hau to ' copy'; label/internal_tags GIU NGUYEN; deep-copy 1 printarea + 2 variant (SKU giu nguyen) + 1 mockup + toan bo Display settings voi ID moi.

[CHK-07-006] Archive roi Unarchive tren product dang lien ket 1 campaign: status quay ve dung gia tri ban dau (0->1->0); campaign_products (id=4057) va campaign_instances.need_sync HOAN TOAN KHONG DOI qua ca archive lan unarchive. PO chi de nghi 'thuc hien va kiem tra' (khong assert truoc ket qua cu the) nen giu OBSERVED_CURRENT, du ket qua phu hop voi ky vong ngam cua PO.

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner); chua biet role khac co bi gioi han archive/unarchive/duplicate/delete hay khong.

api.item: DELETE /api/products/{id} (chap nhan tren ca active lan archived, khi allowed; tra 403 Forbidden {"message":"Product cannot be deleted due to policy restrictions or invalid confirmation token"} khi bi chan boi policy IN_CAMPAIGNS - xac nhan bang bypass UI goi thang endpoint nay, khong chi suy tu hanh vi UI)

data.item: products.status (archive/unarchive toggle); ban sao deep-copy printareas/variants/mockups/display settings voi ID moi

dependencies.relation: deletion-check tra 'IN_CAMPAIGNS' khi product base dang duoc campaign dung, server thuc su chan; archive/unarchive khong doi campaign_products

risks.risk: Response clone (/clone) tra ve record NGUON thay vi ban sao - bat ky consumer nao goi API clone truc tiep (ngoai portal) se khong lay duoc id vua tao tu response, de dan toi loi logic o integration khac.
Muc xac nhan truoc hanh dong pha huy/nhan ban khong nhat quan (archive/duplicate/unarchive khong hoi, chi delete moi hoi) - rui ro thao tac nham khong the hoan tac cho archive/duplicate/unarchive.

[Known limitation - business decision PO, xem KB-091] Muc dich that su cua field 'token' trong deletion-check van chua ro, luon null o moi sample - PO xac nhan hien khong anh huong chuc nang, ghi lai nhu open issue, khong can fix ngay.
Response archive tra full record lo them field chua thay o response khac (variants_position, print_provider_id) - be mat du lieu tra ve khong nhat quan giua cac endpoint.

unknown_areas.question: UI hien thi gi khi deletion-check tra policy='blocked' tren cac ngu canh khac (nhieu campaign cung dung, hoac campaign da archived)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: CHK-07-004 chi test 1 campaign dang active dung san pham; chua kiem tra cac bien the khac cua dieu kien blocked.
